Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly treated Universal Music Group (the distributor) as the parent company of Apple Records, conflating distribution with ownership. This misinterpretation of the corporate relationship would have led to the wrong answer instead of the correct parent company, Apple Corps.
